newsitems.title: Фанаты возмущены внешним видом 2B в кроссовере с Dead by Daylight - разработчики пообещали всё исправить
newsitems.contents:
Коллаборация Dead by Daylight и NieR: Automata стартовала несколько дней назад, однако реакция игроков оказалась далёкой от восторга. Причиной недовольства стали внешний вид и качество проработки персонажа 2B.

Был опубликован короткий ролик, демонстрирующий новый облик (скин), но исполнение модели вызвало у многих фанатов недоумение и разочарование конечным результатом.

Многие пользователи обратили внимание на такие детали, как пропорции и черты лица, телосложение, причёска, платье и даже анимация персонажа. Некоторые даже сравнили текстуру одежды с пластилином Play-Doh и потребовали внести исправления.

Недовольство усилилось на фоне того, что другие персонажи из этого же набора — например, A2 или Эмиль — выполнены качественнее. В сети даже набрал популярность хештег #Fix2B с требованием исправить модель персонажа.

После негативной реакции сообщества разработчики Dead by Daylight сообщили, что в образ, вдохновлённый 2B, будут внесены коррективы, чтобы он больше напоминал оригинального персонажа из NieR:Automata.

Изменения планируется включить в будущий патч с исправлениями ошибок; также рассматривается возможность выпуска второго патча, однако точная дата выхода пока не определена.

newsitems.title: Игроки победили: "мужиковатый" скин 2B в Dead by Daylight исправят после негативной реакции сообщества
newsitems.contents:
Разработчики Behaviour Interactive официально подтвердили, что легендарный скин 2B для Фэн Мин в хорроре Dead by Daylight из недавней коллаборации с NieR: Automata будет изменен. Компания пошла навстречу сообществу после волны жесткой критики, которая обрушилась на косметику сразу после релиза.

Коллекция NieR: Automata появилась в игре 6 октября 2026 года. В нее вошли три основных предмета: легендарный скин 2B для Фэн Мин, легендарный скин A2 для Юи Кимуры и очень редкий скин Эмиля для Легиона. Однако уже в первые часы после выхода игроки начали массово жаловаться на 2B.

Основные претензии касались пропорций тела, силуэта, лица, текстур одежды и общего сходства с оригинальным персонажем из NieR: Automata. Многие отмечали, что модель выглядит слишком "квадратной", "мужиковатой" и просто плохо проработанной по сравнению с A2 и Эмилем, которые в целом получили более позитивные отзывы.

Ситуация дошла до того, что на официальных форумах Behaviour Interactive появилась отдельная тема с требованием переделать модель. 9 октября ведущий комьюнити-менеджер сообщества Мэнди ответила на жалобы:

Мы внесем корректировки в легендарный скин 2B для Фэн Мин, чтобы он стал ближе к оригинальному внешнему виду персонажа. Точных сроков у меня нет, но я ожидаю обновления во втором патче с исправлениями ошибок (но не стоит полностью полагаться на мои слова в отношении последнего пункта!)

Таким образом, разработчики подтвердили, что скин получит корректировки, чтобы он стал ближе к оригинальному дизайну 2B. Компания не раз вносила правки в косметику после критики - например, корректировала модели персонажей или текстуры. В данном случае давление оказалось особенно сильным, потому что речь идет о культовом персонаже из популярной японской игры, а легендарные скины обычно позиционируются как максимально точные и качественные.

newsitems.title: В Dead by Daylight стартовала коллаборация с NieR: Automata
newsitems.contents:
Сегодня студия-разработчик Behaviour Interactive в сотрудничестве с SQUARE ENIX объявила о выходе платной коллекции «NieR:Automata Collection» для асимметричного хоррора Dead by Daylight (формат 4 против 1).

Битва за человечество переносится в Туман: в Dead by Daylight появляются три самых запоминающихся персонажа этой культовой игры — 2B, A2 и Эмиль.

Дэйв Ричард, креативный директор Dead by Daylight, сказал:

Мне кажется, что NieR:Automata оставляет след в душе каждого, кто в неё играет, и мы невероятно рады приветствовать ее в мире Dead by Daylight. Помимо великолепных персонажей и потрясающего визуального ряда, между нашими вселенными существует явная тематическая связь: обе они затрагивают вопросы циклов насилия и страданий. Появление 2B, A2 и Эмиля в Тумане дало нам возможность отдать должное тому, что делает NieR:Automata столь особенной для нас.

В коллекцию NieR:Automata вошли легендарные костюмы 2B и A2 для Фенг Мин и Юи Кимуры соответственно; они превращают полюбившихся игрокам выживших в закалённых в боях андроидов YoRHa, готовых к новым испытаниям. Что касается Убийц, то «Легион» получил костюм очень редкой категории, вдохновлённый образом Эмиля: теперь его уникальная внешность — и пугающая ухмылка — появятся в ходе Испытаний.

newsitems.title: Завтра Dead by Daylight получит коллаборацию с Nier: Automata: в хорроре появятся облики 2B и A2
newsitems.contents:
Похоже, Square Enix заинтересована в выпуске новой игры серии Nier, однако компания также активно использует огромную популярность своих героинь для создания коллабораций с самыми разными проектами. Совсем недавно мы видели 2B в таких играх, как Overwatch, Call of Duty: Mobile и Stellar Blade, а теперь, благодаря сотрудничеству Nier: Automata и Dead by Daylight, она появится и в пугающем Царстве Сущности.

Студия Behaviour Interactive объявила, что в рамках этой коллаборации игроки смогут приобрести легендарные облики 2B и A2 для двух выживших. Это не новые персонажи и не полноценная глава, посвящённая вселенной Йоко Таро, — речь идет исключительно о косметических предметах. Разумеется, некоторые игроки уже выражают недовольство отсутствием обликов для 9S и Эмиля. Наряды поступят в продажу во внутриигровом магазине во вторник, 6 октября 2026 года.

Dead by Daylight — одна из многих игр, добившихся высокой прибыльности благодаря продаже косметических предметов, созданных в сотрудничестве с другими популярными игровыми сериями, комиксами и фильмами. Впрочем, некоторые игроки жалуются, что такой упор на косметику отвлекает от самого игрового процесса, а из-за обилия коллабораций игра теряет свою уникальную индивидуальность.

Dead by Daylight доступная на PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, а также на ПК (в Steam и Epic Games Store).

newsitems.title: Dead by Daylight тизерит кроссовер с NieR: Automata - намёки указывают на новых выживших
newsitems.contents:
Dead by Daylight, похоже, готовит кроссовер с NieR: Automata. Официальный аккаунт игры в X сначала опубликовал загадочный тизер, намекающий на новую косметику для четырёх выживших. Поклонники быстро распознали шрифт на изображении — он принадлежит NieR: Automata.

Затем тот же аккаунт поделился ещё одним тизером, который практически подтверждает сотрудничество: стиль фона и шрифт совпадают с теми, что используются в системах YoRHa из NieR: Automata.

Стоит отметить, что Dead by Daylight давно известна коллаборациями: в игре уже появлялись персонажи из самых разных франшиз, а кроссовер-скины стали привычной частью контента. В ближайшее время игроков также ждёт Арт-клоун и хеллоуинское событие Haunted by Daylight, вдохновлённое эстетикой VHS. На этом фоне новый кроссовер с NieR: Automata выглядит вполне вероятным.

Официального анонса пока нет, поэтому точный состав скинов, дата выхода и другие детали остаются неизвестными. Если слухи подтвердятся, это будет ещё одно крупное сотрудничество для Dead by Daylight.

We want Pharmacy to still allow for the flexibility of finding the other item types by rummaging.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Plunderer's Instinct[/b][/p][list][*][p]You see the aura of Chests and Items. [i](was only within 32/48/64m)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You unlock chests [b]150%/175%/200[/b]% faster. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you unlock a Chest you are[b] [/b]50% more likely to find an item of higher rarity.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We want Plunderer's Instinct to be your go to for improving the efficiency of interacting with Chests. It should have it's place in builds that require you to open Chests.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Premonition [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]While not chased by the Killer, whenever you look in the Killer’s direction within [b]32[/b]m[b]: [/b][i](was 36m and within 45 degrees)[/i][/p][list][*][p]You are notified.[/p][/*][*][p]You see the Killer's Aura for [b]3[/b]s[b]. [/b][i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cooldown: [b]70/65/60[/b]s. [i](was 60/45/30s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We want to modernize this perk by providing an Aura, giving newer players more direct information. To reinforce the need for players to learn how to loop a tile the effect disables in chase.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Road Life [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]While injured and repairing a Generator: [i](was injured and not broken)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Whenever you hit a basic great Skill Check, you earn 1[b] [/b]Token.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose 1[b] [/b]Token.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]When you have 6/5/4 Tokens, you can heal yourself. Spend all Tokens to heal yourself 100%[b] [/b]faster.  [i](now grants the ability to self-heal)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]When you stop healing, this ends after [b]4[/b]s. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We want Road Life to be more usable on it's own so we've given it the ability to self-heal and removed the broken restriction. We also added a quality of life linger so when a heal is interrupted accidentally it's effect isn't instantly cancelled.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Self-Preservation[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain Elusive for [b]13/14/15[/b]s.[i] (was 20/25/30s)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We know that Elusive can be a strong status effect. Several Self Preservations in a lobby can have the unintended effect of the Killer returning back to hook more often. We're reducing the numbers here quite a bit, but are keeping a close eye on this perk.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Shoulder the Burden[/b][/p][list][*][p]Once per trial, while you do not have 2 Hook States, are next to a hooked Survivor use Active Ability Button 2 to unhook them:[/p][list][*][p]They lose 1 Hook State.[/p][/*][*][p]You gain 1 Hook State.[/p][/*][*][p]You scream.[/p][/*][*][p]You become Injured [i](was Exposed for 60/50/40s)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]You become Broken for [b]160/140/120[/b]s[b]. [/b][i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Shoulder the Burden is deactivated for all Survivors. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Shoulder the Burden's incredibly strong effect has not had a sizeable enough downside. We also found that the flexibility of how Shoulder the Burden could be used left little options for counterplay. We still fully expect the perk to be strong in the right hands. However we feel the new downsides and limitation provides more avenues for counterplay. We still aren't completely happy with it's interactions with some other perks, and are keeping a close eye on how the changes are received.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Slippery Meat[i] [/i][/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Other Survivors unhook you [b]90/95/100[/b]% faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you are unhooked, you gain [b]5[/b]% more Haste.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Slippery Meat was only ever effective with full Luck stacking, which lead to unhealthy situations. The intent behind this rework is for Slippery Meat to be a simple and useful form of General anti-tunnel. It's not expected to fully eclipse existing anti-tunnel but be present as an option for newer players.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Small Game[/b] [i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Within [b]10/11/12[/b]m of a Totem, you see its Aura.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We found trying to aim an invisible cone was confusing, especially for newer players. We want the new effect to be a very simple one, aimed at helping new players learn Totem locations.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Solidarity[/b][/p][list][*][p]While injured and healing another Survivor you also gain healing progress at [b]65/70/75[/b]% speed. [i](was without a Med-Kit and 50/60/70%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We removed the restriction that prevented using Solidarity with a Med-Kit to encourage more altruistic usage of Med-Kits.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Spine Chill [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Whenever the Killer looks at you within [b]40[/b]m:[/p][list][*][p]You are notified.[/p][/*][*][p]You cannot scream for [b]12[/b]s.[/p][/*][*][p]You vault [b]10[/b]% faster for [b]12[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cooldown: [b]40/35/30[/b]s[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Return of vault speed Spine Chill, now with a limited duration! We instead want to give players who are looking for the extra challenge more risk and reward from their skill checks. The Special Skill Check is more difficult and no longer activates other Skill Check perks.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]This is Not Happening[/b][/p][list][*][p]Good basic Skill Check zones are [b]150/175/200[/b]% bigger. [i](NEW)[/i][/p][/*][*][p]Great basic Skill Check zones are [b]30[/b]% bigger. [i](was while injured and 10/20/30%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We want this perk to be simple and aimed at newer players, however the injured requirement felt counter to these goals. Only impacting the great zone always meant it's numbers could never be too high due to other perks. Adding the good zone let's us greatly improve the numbers, to better match the intent of a simple perk for new players.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Wake Up![/b][/p][list][*][p]When all Generators are completed:[/p][list][*][p]You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.[/p][/*][*][p]While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura.[/p][/*][*][p]You open Exit Gates [b]8/9/10[/b]% faster, and an additional [b]20[/b]% faster for each other Survivor alive. [i](was 8/10/12.5% per any Survivor alive)[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: We want to improve the Exit Gate opening speed provided by other Survivors. Splitting the bonus between yourself and other Survivors allows us to more precisely balance around our intention of altruistic end game perks. Alone the perk is 2.5% slower than before, and if all Survivors are alive the perk is 20% faster than before.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Windows of Opportunity [/b][i](Rework)[/i][/p][list][*][p]Within[b] 24[/b]m of you see the Auras of Windows.[/p][/*][*][p]You vault Windows [b]10[/b]% faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Whenever you vault a Window, cooldown: [b]40/35/30[/b]s.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev Note: Windows of Opportunity has long reigned as one of the most used perks for it's universal visibility on resources. We feel especially with the inclusion of other options it's a good opportunity to make it specialize in Windows. Players can still gain the old effects of Windows of Opportunity by using the new Dark Sense or combining Windows of Opportunity with Five Moves Ahead.[/i][/p][p][img newsitems.title: Dev Update | 10.2.0 Perks Update
newsitems.author: Goblin_BHVR
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/5ccfbbc06c9408004b81edfdb95f1e0dc5730464.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Fog Dwellers. Today we wanted to talk to you about some of the perk changes (spoiler alert: 58 perks are changing) and content that you can expect in the next PTB, as well as the reasonings behind them.[/p][p]Back in update 9.6.0, we added Diminishing Returns to the game. You may have noticed that this feature did not ship with exponential balance changes to accompany it; we wanted to ease players into the change, monitoring the impact on perk selection first, while we watch to see if any issues arise before making further changes. We feel that now is the time. [/p][p]Our ultimate goal is to update effects that bypass or are minimized by Diminishing Returns, and to buff gameplay effects that can safely be affected by Diminishing Returns to allow players to play around with builds and perks that aren’t picked often. Overall, we will have [b]26 perks[/b] affected by these changes. Today, we will start by highlighting two:[/p][p][b][i]Do No Harm[/i][/b][/p][p][i]While healing another Survivor for each Hook State they have:[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]You heal 30/40/50% faster.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]Great basic Skill Check, grant 3% more progress.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b][i]Increase the odds of triggering a Skill Check by 5%.[/i][/b][/p][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: We wanted Do No Harm to better distinguish itself from We'll Make It and other flat healing speed perks. We added a scaling increase Skill Check odds and made the great skill check bonus scale as well. It should find a home with Survivors who like skill checks and skill check perks.[/i][/p][p][b]Knock Out[/b][/p][p]Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next 6s, if they move [b]10m[/b] away from it, they gain [b]20%[/b] Hindered for 3/4/5s.[/p][p][b]This ends early if the Pallet is broken.[/b][/p][p]Dev Note: [i]We want Knock Out to really feel impactful for those cases where Survivors refuse to loop around a pallet. We've increased the range to account for some longer loops, as our intent is that this should only impact players who intentionally run away from a pallet. We've also updated the removal effect to now also end the Hindered early if the pallet gets broken, even if it's already been applied.[/i][/p][p]On top of adjusting perks that were impacted by Diminishing Returns, we are making changes to [b]23 general perks[/b] to breathe new life into them. We’re also adjusting [b]9 perks[/b] that either promote unhealthy playstyles or are oppressive while avoiding the impacts of Diminishing Returns. We’ll be sharing the full list of changes in tomorrow’s PTB patch notes, so stay tuned![/p][p]While the primary intent behind the general perk changes is to make them more valuable to newer players, we also want to create opportunities for them to be valid options in the wider meta. We’ve focused on buffs and effect changes to general perks to improve their viability while making some of the more confusing perks easier to understand. Although in some cases, we are bringing Tier I and Tier II values closer to what players can expect from a fully upgraded perk to support our newer players.[/p][p]Finally, we wanted to come back to the Survivor Intent System we previously shared with you. This feature will be making its PTB debut this week and we couldn’t be more excited! Put simply, the system allows Survivors to send and receive short, pre-defined text messages mid-match to coordinate, from splitting up, to calling an unhook.[/p][p]This new system will be enabled by default but can be adjusted (like choosing which messages you want to use) or disabled in the Settings menu and comes with muting and anti-spam protections. Plus, based on community feedback, we’ve added a visual signifier to show if someone has this system disabled so you know who’s able to see your messages at a glance. We plan to continue iterating on this system in the future, including adding more selectable messages, so we look forward to hearing your feedback![/p][p]We hope that you’ll look forward to playing around with these new changes on the PTB, and we eagerly await your feedback. You won’t have long to wait, either! The 10.2.0 PTB goes live tomorrow (Sept. 15), alongside full patch notes detailing every change and addition.[/p][p]Until next time…[/p][p]The Dead by Daylight Team[/p]

[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/e140f8b71622b069f7ed7f4a0146c1b835661b2d.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][p][b]The Judgment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the Divine Light curve window while Zealous to 0.8s [i](was 0.6s)[/i][/p][list][*][p][i]Dev note: In hotfix 1 we increased the Zealous Curve window to 0.6s. However, that duration was shorter based on how long Divine Light was controlled - similar to how it was on the PTB. Because it can get pretty short, we felt it was safe to further increase it to 0.8s. We will continue monitoring this.
[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added a 0.3s Divine Light curve window when non-Zealous[/p][list][*][p][i]Dev note: The curving has been a hugely appreciated mechanic to the Zealous state, giving opportunities to outplay Survivors from close range. To give The Judgment an edge when outside of the Zealous state, we're adding a shorter curve window to Divine Light. Zealous is still worth getting due to the longer curve window but being non-Zealous will provide more outplay potential.
[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Survivors being Liberated from Exile respawn at least 32m away from The Judgment and get a 1s immunity to Divine Light[/p][list][*][p][i]Dev note: After spending some time in Exile, returning to the Entity's Realm can be disorienting. Sometimes Survivors come back and The Judgment is right there, re-initiating a chase with them, to no fault of their (The Judgment's) own. To reduce the amount of times a Survivor that is freshly out of Exile gets chased again, we'll be respawning them away from the Killer. The 1s immunity is there to make sure a stray Divine Light doesn't accidentally hit - giving them a proper chance at a reset.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Game Mode: 2v8[/b][/h2][h3][b]NEW KILLER[/b][/h3][p][b]The Xenomorph - Innate Skills:[/b][/p][list][*][p]When a turret takes The Xenomorph out of Crawler Mode it is automatically destroyed[/p][/*][*][p]The cooldown of Crawler Mode is 25% faster while outside of tunnels[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors hit by a Tail Strike are Mangled for 70 seconds[/p][/*][*][p]After exiting a tunnel, gain 5% Haste for 3 seconds[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW ITEM: INVOKING SALT[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Survivors will obtain [b]Invoking Salt[/b] from Chests. It can be used [b]once,[/b] consumed the moment it is placed. Placement takes [b]3 seconds[/b][/p][/*][*][p]When it is placed, up to 4 Survivors can perform a [b]40 second[/b] interaction that allows them to use their [b]Unlockable Skill[/b] without being Hooked and gain a [b]5% Haste[/b] boost for 5 minutes, which reduces by [b]1%[/b] after each minute passes. Performing the Ritual subsequent times will refresh the Haste bonus and duration[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]KILLER UPDATE[/b][/h3][p][b]The Ghostface[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Night Shroud charge rate from [b]15%[/b] to [b]20%[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Increased Stalking charge rate from [b]10%[/b] to [b]15%[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p] Increased Punishment Of The Damned width by [b]2 meters[/b][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]SURVIVOR CLASS UPDATE[/b][/h3][p][b]Guide Class[/b][/p][list][*][p]Successfully completing a Skill Check while the Killer is within [b]24 meters[/b] will reveal their Aura for [b]5 seconds[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Survivor Starting Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]Each Survivor Class is now granted a Default Item of [b]Uncommon [/b]rarity:[/p][list][*][p][b]Medic [/b]- First Aid Kit[/p][/*][*][p][b]Scout [/b]- Dull Key[/p][/*][*][p][b]Escapist [/b]- Artisan's Fog Vial[/p][/*][*][p][b]Guide[/b] - Toolbox[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW MAP[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Nostromo Wreckage is now available in 2v8[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]IMPROVED UNCAGE ANGLES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Uncaging is now supported from the sides, similar to hooks[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]INCREASED CHESTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Number of Chest spawns has been increased from 20 to 27[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Tome's theme can be played in the Offline Lobby by holding Left Click.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Animatronic's default footsteps sounded muffled, and Glitchtrap’s footsteps sounded too metallic.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph’s Tail Strike was too loud.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Xenomorph is unable to hear the turret's beeping warning sound upon approaching it in both Custom and 2v8 Trials.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Characters[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Pig could stay in a crouched state while carrying a Survivor.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where The Pig's un-crouch newsitems.title: Anti-Cheat Trials are now Live
newsitems.author: Goblin_BHVR
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/a9bc5498fa56f20697b8544f986283a28060a9b6.png"][/img][/p][p]Last week, we announced our plans to kick off our Anti-Cheat Trials initiative, and today it's here![/p][p]Starting today, we will be trialing Denuvo's Anti-Cheat solution.

[b]Note that this does not and will not include anything related to DRM, as Denuvo Anti-Cheat is different from Denuvo Anti-Piracy.[/b] Another look at the difference between the two: [/p][p]What we [b][u]ARE[/u] [/b]trialing: Denuvo Anti-Cheat [/p][list][*][p]A tool that detects cheats in-game, identifying people who try to get unfair advantages before they can disrupt fair play [/p][/*][/list][p]What we [b][u]ARE NOT[/u][/b] trialing: Denuvo Anti-Piracy [/p][list][*][p]Tools that prevent the cracking and unauthorized access of game content
 [/p][/*][/list][p]In case you missed it, here's what you can expect:[/p][list][*][p]Anti-Cheat Trials are exclusive to Steam and cross-play will not be impacted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’re continuously testing the compatibility and performance of each anti-cheat provider to ensure you have a seamless experience. Compatibility with Steam Deck and Proton has been tested and will continue to be supported.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The first time you launch the game during the Anti-Cheat Trial, you will be prompted to install Denuvo Anti-Cheat. This is required to play the game.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Please continue to use the in-game report function as normal to report any cheaters you encounter. Detailed comments about what you see (i.e. wallhacks, speedhacks, teleporting) are greatly appreciated; the more context, the better.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Note: Selecting the “Hacking/Exploiting” category when submitting a report covers everything from cheaters to hackers.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]At the end of this Anti-Cheat Trial, Denuvo Anti-Cheat will be automatically deactivated in Dead by Daylight and will no longer run on your system. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A step-by-step guide on how to clean up any remaining Denuvo Anti-Cheat files has been added to our Support Portal should you need it:  [url="https://support.deadbydaylight.com/hc/en-us/articles/52891224375828-Denuvo-Anti-Cheat-FAQ"]Denuvo Anti-Cheat FAQ – Dead by Daylight[/url] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Let us know if you have any feedback about the anti-cheat provider being tested in our dedicated Discord channel, which will also go live today.[/p][/*][/list][p]
What do we expect from you? Simple. Play the game as you normally would, report any cheaters you encounter through the in-game reporting system, and let us know your thoughts on this anti-cheat provider!
[/p][p]We want to reiterate that your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and we'd love to have it every step of the way.
[/p][p]Until next time…  [/p][p]The Dead by Daylight Team [/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Anti-Cheat Trials
newsitems.author: amanda_bhvr
newsitems.contents: [p]Greetings Fog Dwellers! Recently, we shared a survey asking for your thoughts on anti-cheat in Dead by Daylight. One message came through loud and clear: you feel we could be doing more. We hear you and are taking action to bolster and invest in our anti-cheat and security efforts. Put simply, we want you to have the best possible in-game experience, and that means fewer cheaters! While this is just one of many steps in our ongoing commitment to fair play, your involvement and feedback will play a huge part in guiding what comes next. [/p][p] [/p][p]Beginning next week on September 2nd, we’re kicking off our Anti-Cheat Trials initiative as we investigate how different anti-cheat providers improve your in-game experience. What does this mean for you? Over the coming months, we will be running limited-time trials of these providers’ tools, directly in-game on PC, as we gauge their ability to flag cheating behaviour. By comparing your feedback and overall feelings with hard data from each trial, it’ll help us find a solution that works best for Dead by Daylight and for you, our community. [/p][p] [/p][p]Next week’s Anti-Cheat Trial – beginning September 2nd – spotlights Denuvo’s anti-cheat solution. [b]Note that this does not and will not include anything related to DRM, as Denuvo Anti-Cheat is different from Denuvo Anti-Piracy.[/b] Let’s look at the difference between the two: [/p][p]What we [b]ARE [/b]trialing: Denuvo Anti-Cheat [/p][list][*][p]A tool that detects cheats in-game, identifying people who try to get unfair advantages before they can disrupt fair play [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]What we [b]ARE [u]NOT[/u][/b] trialing: Denuvo Anti-Piracy [/p][list][*][p]Tools that prevent the cracking and unauthorized access of game content [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Now, knowing how much of a hot topic anti-cheat can be, we want to make a couple things clear about the Anti-Cheat Trials: [/p][list][*][p]Anti-Cheat Trials are exclusive to Steam and cross-play will not be impacted [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We’re continuously testing the compatibility and performance of each anti-cheat provider to ensure you have a seamless experience. Compatibility with Steam Deck and Proton has been tested and will continue to be supported [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The first time you launch the game during the Anti-Cheat Trial, you will be prompted to install Denuvo Anti-Cheat. This is required to play the game [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Please continue to use the in-game report function as normal to report any cheaters you encounter. Detailed comments about what you see (i.e. wall/speedhacks, teleporting) are greatly appreciated; the more context, the better [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Note: Selecting the “Hacking/Exploiting” category when submitting a report covers everything from cheaters to hackers [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]At the end of this Anti-Cheat Trial, Denuvo Anti-Cheat will be automatically deactivated in Dead by Daylight and will no longer run on your system. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A step-by-step guide on how to clean up any remaining Denuvo Anti-Cheat files will be added to our [url="https://support.deadbydaylight.com/"][u]Support portal[/u][/url], should you need it [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Let us know if you have any feedback about the anti-cheat provider being tested in our dedicated Discord channel, which will also go live on September 2nd [/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]That covers it! To recap, we will be kicking off our first Anti-Cheat Trial on September 2nd, focusing on Denuvo Anti-Cheat. This will [b]not[/b] involve any Digital Rights Management tools. Simply play the game as you normally would, report any cheaters you encounter through the in-game reporting system, and let us know your thoughts on this anti-cheat provider! As we look to the future of fair play in Dead by Daylight, we want to make sure your feedback is at its core! [/p][p] [/p][p]Until next time…  [/p][p]The Dead by Daylight Team [/p]
